comments.author: Doyle
comments.html: I want you, or more likely somebody else who comes here after me, to know that I find your work very cathartic. It quite often pulls me out of poor moods, so thanks.

comments.author: bpatrick
comments.html: I’m not going to lie, Doyle: When I first read your comment my hopes soared and then were dashed and then I ended with my mood substantially elevated. Thank you!

comments.author: 7S
comments.html: I show your comics to my friends.

comments.author: Ian
comments.html:
Winston Rowntree’s AMA from a couple years ago brought me here. I’m usually super skeptical about the whole ‘Conversations with the Master” format, because no one has all the answers and it almost always comes off as preachy or condescending (which is why I’ve never been a fan of Plato’s dialogues with Socrates). But, your character making some important point is always someone new, and every comic is one refreshing new thought. And I’m a sucker for a closing panel with aliens in it. Always makes me think of “Silly Asses” by Isaac Asimov.

So I see why Mr. Rowntree loves it here, and I’ll be coming back many times. Thank you for this.
